question: What is the Full Stack Web Development course?
answer: Full Stack Web Development is a 12-week program priced at ₹6,599. It covers HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React.js, Node.js, Express.js, MongoDB, Git, and deployment. You build 4 real client projects. Certificate and stipend are included. Suitable for beginners.

question: What is the price of Full Stack Web Development?
answer: The Full Stack Web Development program is priced at ₹6,599 (discounted). The program is 12 weeks long and includes a WeIntern certificate, live projects, and stipend opportunities.

question: What is the Mobile App Development course?
answer: Mobile App Development with Flutter is a 10-week program priced at ₹10,699. It covers Flutter, Dart, Firebase, REST APIs, Android/iOS publishing. You build 3 real client apps. Intermediate level. Certificate and stipend included.

question: What is the AI and Automation course?
answer: AI & Automation is an 8-week program priced at ₹6,599. It covers Python, OpenAI API, LangChain, n8n, Make.com, Pinecone, and FastAPI. You build 3 AI projects including an AI chatbot and business automation pipeline. Certificate and stipend included.

question: What is the Cloud Computing and DevOps course?
answer: Cloud Computing is a 12-week program priced at ₹5,399. It covers AWS cloud services, EC2, S3, IAM, VPC, cloud storage, security, and cloud infrastructure management. Real client cloud project work is included. WeIntern completion certificate and performance-based stipend are included.

question: What is the UI UX Design course?
answer: UI/UX Design is an 8-week beginner-friendly program priced at ₹3,299. It covers Figma, Adobe XD, FigJam, design thinking, wireframing, prototyping, and design systems. You complete 3 real client design projects. Certificate and stipend included.

question: What is the Digital Marketing course?
answer: Digital Marketing is a 6-week beginner-friendly program priced at ₹2,499. It covers Google Ads, Meta Ads, SEO, content marketing, Canva, Mailchimp, and Google Analytics. You run real client campaigns. Certificate and stipend included.

question: What is the Data Science course?
answer: Data Science & Analytics is a 12-week intermediate program priced at ₹6,599. It covers Python, Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-learn, Matplotlib, Seaborn, Tableau, and SQL. You complete 3 real data projects. Certificate and stipend included.

question: Which is the cheapest course at WeIntern?
answer: The most affordable WeIntern program is Digital Marketing at ₹2,499 (8 weeks), followed by UI/UX Design, Python, Java, and C/C++ Programming at ₹3,299.

question: Can a beginner join any domain?
answer: Yes. Full Stack Web Development, UI/UX Design, and Digital Marketing are explicitly beginner-level programs and require no prior experience. Mobile App Development, AI & Automation, Cloud DevOps, and Data Science are intermediate-level — basic programming knowledge is helpful.

question: Do all courses provide certificates?
answer: Yes. All WeIntern programs include a WeIntern verified certificate upon successful completion. Certificates can be added to your LinkedIn profile.

question: Is stipend available in all courses?
answer: Yes. All WeIntern programs offer stipend opportunities. The stipend is performance-based and is given upon completing real client projects successfully.

question: What is the DevOps Engineering course?
